meta.title: Held claims: submitted claims not (yet) on the map
meta.notes: Claims from submissions that were not added to the map. status needs_source = no source found yet; a source can promote it to an edge. status misleading = sources point the other way; kept so it can be revisited. raised_in lists the issue numbers that made the claim, so repeats are counted. Not loaded by the map.

statuses.needs_source: No source found that confirms the claim. Send a direct link to promote it.
statuses.misleading: Available sources contradict or do not support the claim as worded.

claims.claim: Batory paid Iustitia 95,000 zł in 2019 for outreach at music festivals and book fairs
claims.checked: Batory's 2019 annual report; only a summary of page 23 could be read, which matches the claim. Needs a word-for-word check of page 23.

claims.claim: Batory gave Iustitia a EUR 50,000 institutional grant in 2022
claims.checked: Batory 2022 annual report pp. 1-37: only a EUR 22,319 project instalment found. The per-grant list of institutional grants was not reached.

claims.claim: The Foundation to Promote Open Society gives Batory about 6.3 million zł a year and is its largest donor
claims.checked: Batory 2019 and 2022 reports name the Open Society donor but give no amounts. Financial statements not yet checked.

claims.claim: The Aequitas judges' association published a tally of Batory money to Iustitia: EUR 156,958 + 95,000 zł
claims.checked: Aequitas document not found. Parts of the tally match Batory reports (2023 EUR 44,639 + 40,000 already on the map; 2022 EUR 22,319 confirmed).

claims.claim: Berek said the Sejm-elected judges have a prepared plan to restore the Tribunal using existing statutory tools, and would not reveal it in advance
claims.checked: Not in OKO.press (11 and 30 Aug 2026) or Interia coverage of his Sejm committee hearing. Sejm committee transcript not checked.

claims.claim: Piotr Serafin, as gatekeeper, unlocked about EUR 137 billion of frozen EU funds for Poland after the 2023 change of government
claims.checked: PAP (18 Sep 2024) calls him gatekeeper for blocking funds under the rule-of-law conditionality mechanism as Budget Commissioner. No source found tying him personally to the unlocking or to the EUR 137bn figure. His tie to Tusk (chief aide 2014-19) is already on the map.
